Hello my name is Milan but most people know me under my nickname "Weedmeister" and I'm 16 years old.


I really enjoy playing on the DREAM Servers, because it really is fun playing with the users on these servers and I know a lot of people here.


My intention on applicating for Test-Admin is because I'd like to support the community and their users, for example translating for my fellow dutch guys, who sometimes don't speak German or English that well. I am capable of speaking German, English, Finnish and, of course, Dutchs.


Getting to be an Admin in your community gives me the possibility to be able to tell people what they are doing wrong using the Admin message box/es. Also I want to support the community by punishing non-acceptable behavior on the server, like racism, cheating and so on.


As a closing remark I just want to thank you for reading my application and I will hopefully be accepted to the Admin Team!


Looking forward to community member responses and the decision of the leaders!


Until then


Have a great day


milan169

Hey Milan,


your application is getting rejected.


It is written badly, is too short, you don't meet some of the requirements needed to apply, you are not integrated in the community.


@Vengeance has given you some good advice in his post in your other thread, definitely do what he said.
Meaning, use your time and visit our TeamSpeak, be more active ingame, read the forum and reply to the threads you can reply to, post suggestions and more.


Also, even though you have dyslexia, try maybe asking someone else to proofread and help you with your application.


If you want to reapply in the future, read the requirements first: Application Requirements | Read before posting!


Try following the example application if you find it hard to write your own application. You can find it here.
Application Example | Read before posting!


Since this application is rejected, you get one (1) application point.
You are now not allowed to apply for one month.
